harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 11 requests of probe.py 34 (eleventh build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: THE DIAGNOSTIC OF THE WAIT BEHIND ONE PRODUCER WITH ITS SERVED FIRST READER - the producer alone on write barrier 1, its destination holding a marker from the top of every iteration, the word that carries the wait behind it, the producer's stall count = the distance of the waiting word (1 ... 8 cycles), and the word that waits is the producer's first reader as a served kernel holds it ("forms": "A", "served"): f_mlg - `MUFU.LG2 R32, R21` read IN PLACE by `FADD.FTZ R32, R32, R26` (R26 = the marker with its sign turned); f_tid - `S2R R32, SR_TID.X` read by `SHF.R.U32.HI R24, RZ, 0x5, R32`; f_bfl - `SHFL.BFLY PT, R32, R21, 0x2, 0x1f` read by `SEL R24, R21, R32, !P0` (P0 true). Three variants: f_<x> = no yield flag on the producer; f_<x>_y = THE PRODUCER carries the yield flag (and, for mlg and bfl, the reader too, as served); f_<x>_n = the control without barrier and wait (the reader 1, 2, 4, 8, 15 and 30 cycles behind the producer: how long the word takes by itself). f_mex, f_mex_y: the diagnostic's own reference with `MUFU.EX2 R32, R21` and its reader `MOV R24, R32`. Fronts: no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

provenance.dep_table_commit: 53c8224c tools/stallfloor/probe.py 27 and 28: a wait under another predicate (kind gp), the readers of a CS2UR result, a

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
